```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(50)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.10)

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
clusters = samp_3[,,1]
dims = rep(2,nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_3[, , i])
}

dims = rep(2,nspheres)
angular = FALSE
landmark_size = .1
ls <- n*landmark_size
# find centroids
landmarks_centroids <- get_centroids(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)

clear3d()

mfrow3d(nr = 1, nc = 2, sharedMouse = TRUE)  
plot3d(clusters[,1:3],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),zlim = c(-1, 1), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2", main="Centroids and nearest neighbors, landmark size = 10%", pch = 19)
points3d(landmarks_centroids[,1:3], pch=10)


plot3d(clusters[,4:6],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),zlim = c(-1, 1), col = rainbow(n),
```

## 8/22/2023
```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(50)
n <- 200
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = .1
ls <- n*landmark_size
# compare centroids to nearest points to centroids
landmarks <- get_center(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
landmarks_centroids <- get_centroids(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)


results <- compare_centers(x = clusters, dims = dims, angular = angular, landmark_size = landmark_size)
l_center <- results[1:ls,]
l_centroid <- results[(ls+1):(2*ls),]
plot(clusters,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2", main="Centroids and nearest neighbors, landmark size = 10%", pch = 19)
points(polySphereToAngles(l_center,dims)-pi, pch=10)
points(polySphereToAngles(l_centroid,dims)-pi, pch=16)
legend(1, 3, legend=c("(S^1)^2", "Centroids", "Centers"),
       pch = c(19,16,10), col = c('red','black','red'), lty=1:3, cex=0.8)
for(i in 1:ls){
  p1 <- polySphereToAngles(l_center[i,],dims)-pi
  p2 <- polySphereToAngles(l_centroid[i,],dims)-pi
  segments(x0 = p1[1],y0= p1[2],x1=p2[1],y1=p2[2],col='black')
}


```

```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache = TRUE)

set.seed(10)
n <- 100
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = .1

time <- Sys.time()
res_centroid <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .5, dims=dims, angular=angular, landmark_tol = 5e-4, tol = 5e-4, landmarks_centroid = TRUE)
# profvis({res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, landmark_tol=5e-6)})
centroid_time <- Sys.time() - time


time <- Sys.time()
res_subset <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, dims= dims, angular = angular, landmark_tol=5e-4,tol=5e-4, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)
# profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters)})
subset_time <- Sys.time() - time


time <- Sys.time()
res <- plot_MDS(clusters,dims=dims, angular=angular,tol=5e-4)
# profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters)})
normal_time<- Sys.time() - time

residual_centroids1 <- sum(res_centroid[,1]-res[,1])^2/var(res[,1])
residual_subset1 <- sum(res_subset[,1]-res[,1])^2/var(res[,1])
residual_centroids2 <- sum(res_centroid[,2]-res[,2])^2/var(res[,2])
residual_subset2 <- sum(res_subset[,2]-res[,2])^2/var(res[,2])
score_residuals <- c(residual_centroids1,residual_subset1,residual_centroids2,residual_subset2)
times <- c(normal_time, centroid_time,subset_time)
print(score_residuals)
print(times)

```
